panels.description: Uses only the synthetic column="total" series. This is the database-wide value used by the current 4 GiB warning alert; do not sum it with the per-column series.
panels.title: Worst pod: total pending compaction

panels.description: Maximum real column-family backlog. The configured RocksDB soft and hard pending-compaction limits are 6 GiB and 12 GiB per column family.
panels.title: Worst column: pending compaction

panels.description: 1 means RocksDB has stopped accepting writes.
panels.title: Writes stopped

panels.description: Non-zero means RocksDB is actively throttling application writes.
panels.title: Delayed write rate

panels.description: Cumulative RocksDB background errors. Any non-zero value requires investigation.
panels.title: Background errors

panels.description: Only leveled column families currently report meaningful pending-compaction bytes. Universal-compaction families report zero, so use the L0 and memtable panels below to evaluate their pressure.
panels.title: Pending compaction by column family

panels.description: All column families are included. Rising L0 files are a pressure signal even where pending-compaction bytes are unavailable under universal compaction.
panels.title: L0 files by column family

panels.description: Filesystem operations per second issued by the selected Madara container, broken out by block device and direction. Use this to correlate compaction pressure with volume I/O activity.
panels.title: Madara volume IOPS

panels.description: Active plus immutable memtable memory for every selected column family.
panels.title: Memtable bytes by column family

panels.description: Immutable memtables waiting for flush. Growth indicates flush pressure and can precede write stalls.
panels.title: Immutable memtables by column family

panels.description: File distribution for every selected column family. Use the Column variable to narrow this panel when many families are selected.
panels.title: SST files by column and LSM level

panels.description: Physical SST size for each selected column family.
panels.title: On-disk size by column family

panels.description: Detailed memtable pressure for the three leveled Bonsai log families. Delete entries are point tombstones generated by prefix pruning.
panels.title: Bonsai log memtable entries and deletes

panels.description: Boolean RocksDB property signals for each Bonsai log family.
panels.title: Bonsai compaction and flush pending

panels.description: The gap between physical column size and estimated live data indicates obsolete data/tombstones still present in SSTs.
panels.title: Bonsai estimated live data vs physical size

panels.description: Key population and the number of live RocksDB versions retained for each Bonsai log family.
panels.title: Bonsai estimated keys and live versions

panels.description: Steady-state retention and reorg cleanup both call prefix removal. Outcome labels expose scan, write, and joint failures.
panels.title: Prefix-prune operations/s

panels.description: Any outcome other than success. scan_and_write_error preserves both failure dimensions.
panels.title: Prefix-prune errors/s

panels.description: Latest revision whose prefix deletion completed successfully. Multiple values are shown when multiple pods or Bonsai log columns are selected.
panels.title: Last fully pruned revision

panels.description: Latency distribution for successful prefix deletion. p95 highlights occasional expensive retention revisions.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, pod, column) (rate(bonsai_prefix_prune_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, pod, column) (rate(bonsai_prefix_prune_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Successful prune duration

panels.description: The count histogram shows the typical and tail number of iterator entries examined per revision; this is why count buckets are useful here.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, pod, column) (rate(bonsai_prefix_prune_entries_scanned_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, pod, column) (rate(bonsai_prefix_prune_entries_scanned_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Entries scanned per successful prune

panels.description: Serialized RocksDB write-batch size generated by each successful prefix removal.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, pod, column) (rate(bonsai_prefix_prune_batch_bytes_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, pod, column) (rate(bonsai_prefix_prune_batch_bytes_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Deletion batch bytes per successful prune

panels.description: Point-delete operations placed into each successful RocksDB write batch. Tail values identify unusually large tombstone bursts.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, pod, column) (rate(bonsai_prefix_prune_batch_operations_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, pod, column) (rate(bonsai_prefix_prune_batch_operations_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Deletion operations per successful prune

panels.description: Cumulative RocksDB statistics converted to per-second rates. These series require database statistics to be enabled.
panels.title: Application, flush, and compaction throughput

panels.description: Running RocksDB compaction and flush jobs.
panels.title: Background jobs

panels.description: Compaction output divided by flush output. Requires database statistics.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(db_compact_write_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (pod) (rate(db_flush_write_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])), 1)

panels.title: Write amplification

panels.description: Fraction of wall-clock time spent stalled. Any sustained non-zero value means writes are being delayed.
panels.title: Write stall fraction

panels.description: Cache hits divided by hits plus misses. Requires database statistics.
panels.title: Block-cache hit ratio

panels.description: Key-write and existing-key-update rates provide a database-wide activity baseline around pruning windows. Requires database statistics.
panels.title: RocksDB key write activity

panels.description: Snapshots can retain old versions and prevent obsolete SST data from being reclaimed.
panels.title: Open RocksDB snapshots

panels.description: Age of the oldest unreleased RocksDB snapshot.
panels.title: Oldest snapshot age

panels.description: Normally zero. This low-volume instrumentation distinguishes reorg-triggered cleanup from steady-state retention pruning.
panels.title: Trie-revert attempts/s

panels.description: 95th-percentile duration when trie reverts occur.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, pod, trie, outcome) (rate(bonsai_trie_revert_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Trie-revert duration p95

panels.description: 95th-percentile number of revisions traversed by a revert attempt.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, pod, trie, outcome) (rate(bonsai_trie_revert_revisions_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Trie-revert revisions p95
